Sar.reason: Sar refers to the sarcasm label (Sar vs Non-Sar) in the dataset tables, not a human language, so it is a false positive

German.reason: German refers to a German-language dataset (MuSaG) that the paper evaluates on to test cross‑lingual prosodic incongruity, so the language is studied in the experiments

English.reason: English refers to English-language datasets (MUStARD, etc.) used for training and evaluation, and to English‑centric pretraining, so the language is studied in the paper
